verified: successful native hash, line count, and exclusive JSON write byte accounting
returned hash prefix preserved across a later unknown read failure
known short write counted as returned bytes without unknown-byte inflation
flush, fsync and close failures capture durability uncertainty
manifest hash open failure, link rejection, cap, duplicate action and unsafe path fail closed
poisoned ledger rejects later operations without retry
durability_boundary: snapshot() is an in-memory deep copy. It is not durable until the independent caller writes it; interruption before that external write remains unknown/spent.
